children.prompt: If $M$ is the midpoint of $CB$, find the exact values of:

answer.worked:
The median $VM$ of the equilateral face is perpendicular to $CB$, and $CM=5$.
$$\begin{align*}VM^2&=10^2-5^2\\VM^2&=75\\VM&=5\sqrt{3}.\end{align*}$$

The centre $E$ of the square base is 5 units from the midpoint $M$ of its side. Triangle $VEM$ is right-angled.
$$\begin{align*}VE^2&=VM^2-EM^2\\VE^2&=75-25\\VE^2&=50\\VE&=5\sqrt{2}.\end{align*}$$
